column1: # What the upstream-drift workflow watches, and the single source of truth for it.
# build/check-upstream.sh reads this; it knows how to query each ecosystem but nothing about which
# components this repository binds. Adding a native SDK means adding a row here.
# Columns are single-tab-separated.
#   group    reporting group - one GitHub issue per group, titled with this text
#   label    how the component is named inside the issue
#   kind     cocoapods | maven | github-release | github-tag
#   pin      the MSBuild property in Directory.Build.props holding the pinned version
#   locator  kind-specific: pod name, groupId:artifactId[:packaging][@repo], or owner/repo[:strip]
#   confirm  download URL template with {version}, or "-" to derive it from the locator
# There is no Maven-style feed for the Apple binaries. arthenica/ffmpeg-kit is archived with every
# release stripped of assets, ffmpeg-kit-next is source-only, and dev.ffmpegkit-maintained (which
# the Android bindings use) publishes .aar files only - so the ffmpeg_kit_flutter fork is the only
# source still shipping xcframeworks. See build/FetchXcFrameworks.sh and the README.
# That fork tags one version once per variant (8.1.2-audio, 8.1.2-full, 8.1.2-min and five more),
# so the locator carries a sed expression that reduces a tag to its bare version. Without it every
# tag looks like a prerelease and the component would silently never report.
# The confirmation names one variant's xcframework because a release is cut whole: if the -full tag
# is up, the other seven are too, and if it is not, nothing here is fetchable anyway.
# group
FFmpegKit
